title: BRICS Tests Its Consensus
gist: A Warcast episode note: the 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi produced a joint declaration despite deep divisions, including members on opposite sides of the Middle East war, as the bloc's membership keeps growing.

insights.claim: The 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi in September 2026 produced a joint declaration despite deep divisions, including between members on opposite sides of the war in the Middle East.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: BRICS can still agree on paper, but internal splits cap its ability to act as a unified economic or de-dollarization bloc.

insights.claim: BRICS membership continues to grow, which raises questions about the bloc's future direction and its ability to maintain consensus.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Expansion dilutes cohesion; be skeptical of BRICS-led financial architecture headlines.
